title: Guided bone regeneration using high density PTFE membranes. Case Series
authors: Iker Bellanco, David Chávarri, Esteban Pérez, Markel Diéguez, Iratxe Viteri, Aritza Brizuela. 2019. Poster Osteology Barcelona.
studyType: Poster or congress abstract (not peer reviewed)
supports: Clinical study from the botiss permamem (dense PTFE) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The use of d -PTFE membranes seems to present satisfactory results in GBR, although some incidents like membrane exposure were seen, they did not have a major importance in the final outcome. However more randomized clinical trials are needed to determine the effectiveness of this procedure” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
